neighbours.label: Engineering and electrical design vocabulary in technical or standards text: fires on ' engineering', ' electrical', ' design' and nearby words when the passage is about engineered equipment or structures
fire: Our consultants handle the mechanical engineering and electrical design of new pumping stations.
Every panel must be built with UL listed electrical components and tested before use.
The standard sets minimum design loads for towers, masts and other steel structures.
She studied civil engineering and now checks the design of highway bridges.
Grounding and shielding of electrical equipment are covered in the IEEE guide.
The contractor completed the structural design of the new laboratory wing in May.
Wind engineering of tall buildings relies on tunnel tests and careful load modelling.
The plant's electrical systems were upgraded after an engineering review of the switchgear.
quiet: Our consultants handle the payroll accounting and tax filing of new retail branches.
Every dish must be made with locally grown vegetables and tasted before serving.
The handbook sets minimum reading lists for history, poetry and other arts courses.
She studied medieval history and now checks the dates of church records.
Feeding and grooming of show horses are covered in the club guide.
The author completed the final chapter of the new travel memoir in May.
Wine tasting in small villages relies on local guides and careful note taking.
The school's music lessons were expanded after a parents' review of the timetable.

notes: Probes: 'structural engineering and electrical design services' 0.51, 'IEEE and UL standards for electrical equipment' 0.63, 'mechanical design and careful load analysis' 0.21; tax-advice and novel versions 0.02-0.03. The + pole fires on the names of engineers and inventors and its output promotes ' engineer', ' engineering'.
